spans.s: मेध् vt. or vi. 1U (pres. मेधति-ते) The same as मेथ् q.v.
मेध m. 1. A sacrifice; 2. a sacrificial animal.

मेधा f. (This word is changed to मेधस् in Bahu. compounds after सु, दुस् and the negative prefix अ) 1. The retentive power of memory, retentiveness; 2. intelligence, intellect, Bg.x.34, M.iii.263; 3. a sacrifice.
मेध-ज m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
मेधा-रुद्र m. an epithet of Kālidāsa.
मेधा-विन् (I) a. endowed with intellect, possessed of mental power.
मेधा-विन् (II) m. 1. a learned man; 2. an intoxicating beverage; 3. a parrot.
मेधि f. A pillar to which beasts are tethered.
मेध्य (I) a. (f. ध्या) 1. Fit for a sacrifice, M.v.54; 2. relating to a sacrifice, sacrificial, R.xiii.3; 3. pure, purified, holy, R.i.84, xiv.81.
मेध्य (II) m. 1. A goat; 2. (the khadira tree; 3. barley.
मेध्य (I) a. (f. ध्या) 1. Fit for a sacrifice, M.v.54; 2. relating to a sacrifice, sacrificial, R.xiii.3; 3. pure, purified, holy, R.i.84, xiv.81.
